Both Jimmy Fallon and the NFL seem to love instant replays. So the “Tonight Show” host recapped President Donald Trump’s defeat in the midterms and the aftermath using all 32 NFL team names. (Watch the video below.)

“The midterms were a big deal,” Fallon began in a post-“Sunday Night Football” monologue. “Millions of Patriots went to the polls and voted. Trump thought he’d win. He did a bunch of rallies Raven about his accomplishments but he forgot he’s one of the least popular Commander in Chiefs we’ve ever had. Voters were sick of him Lion about inflation, lowering gas prices. I mean, if you wanna fill up your Ram or Jag, you are gonna pay a million Bucs. You might as well hop on a Colt to get around town.”

That was just the start. Some of his work-ins hilariously reached a little (we’re lookin’ at you, Cowboys, Panthers and Bengals) ― but not every play works in football either. See for yourself:

Last week, on another special Sunday edition of “The Tonight Show,” the comedian sacked the president on another front.

“We’re coming to ya after tonight’s game between the Chicago Bears and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers,” he said. “The Bears have a tough schedule with games against the Lions, Jaguars, Dolphins and Seahawks. Basically, all of the animals from Trump’s cognitive test.”
